answers.core: Displaying text in a 3D world is often done throughout the development of a 3D game. Even if it never ends up being used during actual gameplay, text in the 3D world is sometimes used during level blockouts as well to denote landmarks in the blockout.
answers.workaround: This can be done using a custom shader, but it's still quite a lot of work to do manually and expose in a convenient way. Nonetheless, it's still possible to develop this as an add-on.

title: Add a Label3D node to display text in a 3D world using SDF font rendering
